name: Mallet (glockenspiel / marimba)

beschreibung.text: Glockenspiel: two triangles at an inharmonic +2 oct +6 st, a bright filter tick, 1.2 s decay, plate and a soft 16th delay.

notiz: Source rule: recipe card `keys.mallet`, Welsh [B1] pp. 82–83, patches Glockenspiel and Marimba, tables transcribed.. Measured by `tests/rezepte.rs`, not yet heard. Manifest use words outside the vocabulary: melody (as drop).
